name: Abandoned Cart Recovery
description: Abandoned cart recovery for OpenCart 4.x — captures carts of logged-in customers and of guests who entered an e-mail, marks them abandoned after N minutes, sends reminder e-mails with a one-time recovery link (only the token hash is stored), auto-detects recovered carts from new orders, admin list with status filter and statistics tiles. Pro: chain of up to three reminders, personal single-use coupon, Telegram notification, CSV export.
author: CatCode
